role: Post-hoc public diagnostic, not model selection, a new learning candidate or final evaluation
selection: All 33 initial models on these first three complete public identities, 99 trajectories, including every failure. Their task outcomes have already been inspected; support distances have not.
representation: 18 existing actor fields: reference-relative velocity, reference-relative position, measured motion, estimated wrench, route direction; fixed physical scaling and actor clipping, no fitted transform
calibration: Nearest distance for each training sample to all OTHER training identities, excluding its whole trajectory; pooled 95th percentile. No validation or development values calibrate the threshold.
report: Per trajectory median/p95/max instantaneous distance, fraction above training calibration, component clipping fraction, original task/strict/full-horizon. Preserve per-frame distance and trace hashes.
limitations: Does not include recurrent state, estimate calibrated OOD probability, establish causation or make independent-frame statistical claims. No counterfactual teacher labels or new fits.
compute: Spark read-only trace extraction, local one-thread3GiB distance computation; zero new simulation episodes
